name: NumberTicker
description: A number that counts up (or down) to its value once after it appears. The final number is always the text that is read and that is in the server HTML.

from.description: The number the count starts from.

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point, always shown.

startWhenInView.description: Waits until the number scrolls into view before counting.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for the digits and separators. Defaults to the locale of the visitor.

isPaused.description: Skips the count and shows the final value.

requirements: The final formatted value is always in the accessible text; the counting digits are hidden from assistive technology so nothing is read number by number
The server HTML contains the final value, so it is correct with no JavaScript
The count starts after mount only and runs once, for under two seconds by default
Visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and anything inside rdm-still, see the final value at once
Digits use tabular figures so the number does not jitter while it counts
Formats with the locale of the visitor through useDefaultLocale, so server and browser agree on first render
screenReader: Read once as the final number, never as a stream of changing values

use_when: A headline figure on a landing page or dashboard that should feel alive
A statistic that appears as the section scrolls into view
avoid_when: Figures people compare closely or copy, where a static number is calmer
anti_patterns: Counting every number in a table
Running the count for many seconds
